purpose: 12-question A–F readiness diagnostic for digital trade / electronic trade documents (MLETR). Grades corridor legality, document digitisation, platform connectivity, trade-rule basis (eUCP/URDTT), financing, and AML/TBML controls; routes to the right chain and emits a remediation checklist.
